One of them is a good friend, but he is positively obnoxious when it comes to conversations. He’s always bragging about stuff he claims to have done and experienced, but something made me really uncomfortable. I started laughing and asked him why he’d think we believe him. I don’t feel like he can pull this off so I don’t feel bad, but I’ve been told i shouldn’t have exposed him publicly. So, AITA?
